DESIGN A / HERITAGE BISTRO

One space.
A continuous story.

This navigable model interprets the selected A concept: ivory walls, walnut joinery, cognac seating, cream tabletops and warm brass lighting.

This A01 revision uses a 10-foot internal width and a shallower depth calibrated to the concept image. Dining leads to the service counter, with preparation, cold storage and the cooking line behind.

The 3D geometry was built in Blender and is rendered here with Three.js. It is a design study rather than a measured construction model; equipment sizes and clearances require site verification.

Explore with section buttons, drag to look around, or use WASD / arrow keys along the circulation route. Cutaway reveals the complete layout. The guided tour visits all five sections and stops at the kitchen.

Original A01 concept reference · The 3D model is an interpretation of this design.
